title: Personal Training Packages: gift-certificate purchasability, session transferability, and family sharing by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether the tier may be purchased as a gift certificate, whether its unused sessions may be transferred to another member and the fee for doing so, and whether its sessions may be redeemed by a household add-on dependent.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Purchasable as a gift certificate | Sessions transferable to another member | Transfer fee (USD) | Redeemable by a household add-on dependent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | Yes | No | 0.00 | No |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | Yes | No | 0.00 | No |
| 10-Session Value Pack | Yes | Yes | 20.00 | No |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Yes | Yes | 20.00 | No |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | No | No | 0.00 | No |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | No | No | 0.00 | No |

## Points of reference
Only 10-Session Value Pack and 20-Session Performance Pack allow their unused sessions to be transferred to another member, each at the same 20.00 dollar transfer fee; every other tier of Personal Training Packages does not allow session transfer, and lists no transfer fee. Four of the six tiers may be purchased as a gift certificate; Unlimited Monthly Coaching and Elite Specialty Coaching may not. No tier currently allows its sessions to be redeemed by a household add-on dependent.
